defects.what: 10px timestamps and chips, 11.5px snippets in faint grey in a list read all day
Star and more buttons about 26px; more invisible until hover
Archive and delete, the main triage actions, are not on rows
Reply sits at the end of the message in secondary style
One accent means brand, primary, selection, unread and danger; avatar tints mean nothing
Account avatar and message count each shown two or three times
On phone, row buttons, Compose and toolbar buttons about 33px
Discard draft is a bare trash icon next to a close X that saves; no visible difference
Compose is modal, blocking the message being replied to; no Cc, Bcc or attach
Order reverses frequency; duplicates the toolbar
Delete directly under Archive with no gap; unclear if permanent
Icons switch meaning; focus lands on the close X
defects.note: The focus-ring part may come from the harness: surfaces are opened with a scripted click, and Chrome shows focus rings when there was no real pointer input.

defects.what: Toast covers content, does not say which message, small Undo
Omits frequent triage shortcuts; help shown on touch phones
Unlabeled opener; popover covers headers; missing common filters

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)
